Same-denominator fixed nonnegative weighted sums preserve the cross-multiplied inequality by linearity.
claims.reason: Independent exact reconstruction gives component minors -10,-80 and summed minor +909; positive denominator products preserve these ratio directions. The report states the valid same-denominator repair and its limits.
